# Project instructions
 
This repository analyses electronics test-station measurement data.
 
- All analysis scripts are Python 3; use pandas only (no other data libraries).
- Voltage limits: 3.0-3.6 V. Temperature limits: 0-60 C.
- Never modify files in data/ - they are raw exports and read-only.
- When you produce a report, write it as a Markdown file in reports/.
